CHAOS EMERALD MOD

This mod has a lot of features, as well as planned updates when the base mod is finished. I will list the first version and everything complete with it, so that you can easily understand everything I'd like to have done. I've been planning this mod for years, so I know exactly what it should contain. 

This mod should have three assigned buttons in the options menu  
Transform  
Transform (Group)  
Toggle Block Destroying Ability (Toggle)  
Ability Shortcut (while equipped in curios slot emerald ability still is able to be used)

This mod will require the create mod for some mechanical recipies. 

Leave comments on things you'd like to understand or have any further questions on\!

First\! Before i  forget, the staple outfit that sells the idea your a genius that wants to utilize all aspects of emeralds\!

Dr Kenetix (Boombrain) Clothing Set:  
Each piece has unique effects  
Head 4 DEF: Infinite Night Vision. Built in goggles for create.  
Chest 6 DEF: Extra minute spent in forms.  
Pants 5 DEF: Creepers are neutral to you.  
Shoes 3 DEF: Speed increases depending on health. Maximum 125% at half a heart. 

Eventually when everything is implemented i want this mod to have a theme, nature vs machine, with the ability to only use one. Chaos emeralds, or create mod \+ robots and machines added by this mod. 

![][image1]

Chaos emeralds act as magic, ignoring 50 percent of defense from any target, making them usable early or late game. Recharge emeralds with experience by right clicking with them in hand on the master emerald.   
(Recharge at Skill Tree Pillars when implemented instead)

Biomes for the Emeralds   
Green: Plains/Jungle  
Purple: Cherry Grove/Deep Dark  
Blue: Snowy Plains/Taiga  
Light Blue: Every Ocean  
Grey: Stony Peaks/Dripstone Caves  
Yellow: Crimson/Warped Forest  
Red:Nether Wastes/Basalt 

Every emerald will have 4 abilities. However only basic matters for this stage. Each emerald has one ability unlocked at this stage, and one buff equipped using a dedicated emerald curios slot.The abilities will go as such:

Basic: The ability an emerald comes with.   
Destructive: Always deals environment damage.  
Utility: Aids movement or affects the world positively.  
Defense: Heals or defends the player.

Chaos Emeralds  
Cooldowns adjustable to balance  
Costs 1 hunger to use each to prevent spam  
While holding the emerald, this item isn't held by the player visually, Instead it revolves around the player.

Red: Dancing Flames  
Leap forward cloaked in flames, leaving a trail of fire as you move. This move can be used midair to do a double jump, and while on the ground, this move acts like a boost where you gain ledge assist and dash forward, harming enemies as you move. (Warning, very fast)

Blue: Storm Flurry

Basic: send forth several projectiles made of electric  wind by kicking your feet at super speeds. These projectiles inflict enemies with slow, chain lightning on nearby hostiles when hit. Up to five can be shot by holding the right click down before needing to cooldown. These projectiles leave windy trails temporarily you can walk on.

Light Blue: Psychic Drive

After grabbing a target, compress them with telekinetic force.The longer you hold, the more your hunger drains. Deals a heart per second and levitates the target. Drains hunger rapidly. 

Yellow: Speared Parry:  
Parry lasts 15 frames. If mob hits during those frames damage is dealt back x2 via a chaos spear that relentlessly tracks the attacker, and grants the user speed 2 and resistance 1 for 30 seconds. If used correctly the user can negate fall damage while parry window is active 

Purple: Binding Tendrils:  
Aiming at a location on the ground, a tendril sprouts from the ground, and wraps around the target, draining their life energy. This move can be escaped early if the player mashes space. Drains half a heart a second, and negates healing from the binded character. If used near crops, the tentacle will harvest nearby crops with fortune 3 in a 5x5 area near the target location.

Grey: Heavenly Beam:  
A beam from above that deals constant damage. It also ascends the player upwards to gain height. Sends shockwaves on the impact area, dealing slow and weak to targets but doesn't harm them.  
Cooldown: 30 seconds.  
Power: 2 hearts base damage.  
:  
Green: Chaos Snap:  
Homes in on the closest entity and bounces off them, and deals high damage and applies slow and weak to the target. If used with toggle on, the player can instead teleport in whatever direction they are facing, up to 12 blocks away. (Cannot phase into or through walls)  
Cooldown: 12 seconds.  
Power: 5 hearts base damage. 

Black: Black Chaos:  
Fire an x projectile that pierces all defense. Tracks slightly. Inflicts wither, and weakens the master emerald.   
Cooldown: 25 seconds.

SUPER EMERALD ABILITIES:  
These won't have a skill tree. One ultimate ability can be unlocked via the regular emeralds skill tree\!\!\!\!  
Each ability takes 24 hours to cooldown

Red: ULTIMATE Flux:  
Punch the ground very hard, erupting magma pillars forward in the direction you were looking, reaching up to cloud level. This obliterates form timers.

Blue: ULTIMATE Tempest:  
Summon a tornado at where the player is looking. This tornado occasionally shoots lightning bolts at nearby entities, and anything to touch this tornado is shot upwards. Lightly sucks things from a distance, and moves on its own in a circle before disappearing 

Light Blue: ULTIMATE Cortex:   
Generate a large, psychic barrier around the player. This barrier has a lot of hp, and cannot be crossed by anybody, even the player. The barrier lasts 2 minutes, but can be dispersed if the player right clicks it. 

Yellow: ULTIMATE Overdrive:  
Jump very high into the sky, and release a volley of chaos spears that ignore i frames. Fire up to 90 total with poor accuracy at an extremely fast rate, like a machine gun burst. Spears deal weak damage (3 per spear) 10 spears a second for 9 seconds. Mk

Purple: ULTIMATE Annihilation:   
Charge up an extremely powerful chaos blast, this charge lasts 20 seconds, and arcs energy around your body. After the charge up, release a nuke of energy that obliterates blocks around the player in a very large area. This grants you glowing during the effect, and while you charge up you are vulnerable to attacks. You are very easy to kill during this process, as lightning will regularly drop near your location as you attempt this. The damage caused by this ability is great, up to 30 hearts depending how close you are. (Cannot destroy blocks for claims or areas you can't destroy blocks) Your defense during this period becomes 10, regardless of armor worn.

Grey: ULTIMATE Resonance:  
Rain beams from the sky\! These beams do not target anything, they randomly drop and deal major damage to hostile mobs and players. These beams also cut through defense like butter.

Green: ULTIMATE Chaos Control:  
Concentrate over a large area, pulling in all players, and mobs and forcing them into your pocket dimension. This area is quite large, and they are stuck for 10 seconds with ai disabled to wait for you to load in. The portal out of this pocket dimension disappears for 3 minutes unless the player right clicks on the portals location.

Buffs when one is equipped in curios slot:

Red: Fire Resistance

Blue: Speed

Light Blue: Dolphins Grace

Yellow: Resistance 

Purple: Fortune

WHEN ALL 7 EMERALDS ARE GATHERED  
Player can press the transform button to transcend into   
SUPER FORM\!  
If the player somehow dies during this transformation due to falling out of the world or a bug, the emeralds return to the player's inventory.

Super form: 3 minutes.  
Old reliable  
Invincible to all attacks, all base damage that hits during transformation subtracts that many seconds from the remaining time transformed.  
Drains all 7 emeralds once transformation ends.  
Costs 5 levels per emerald to recharge.  
To recharge, place emeralds around the master emerald. Right click each emerald and if you have enough experience, the emeralds positive energy will be restored.

Stats:  
Flight (mouselook flight, not creative) that drains hunger as you use it. 0 hunger doesnt damage super but having 0 hunger disables flight, invulnerability and combat abilities.  
Water running   
Auto step (ledge step)  
Speed 7  
Strength 3  
Jump Boost 4  
Fire Resistance

Passive:  
Player can push (share form) button to transform players or mobs close by (3x3 area).  
Aura draws in items from long distances  
The player emits light in a 5x5 radius

Abilities:

Super Spear: shoot 3 individually tracking chaos  spears that ignore damage buffers.  
Power : 6 base damage each  
Refill 2 second on each hit.

Super Blast: Large radius chaps blast that destroys dirt, and water. Also deals more damage  
Power : 5  base damage   
Refill 1 second on each enemy hit

Super Boost: Spindash forward up to 20 blocks mid-air, dealing good damage.  
Power: Deals 10 base damage  
Refill 3 seconds on each hit

Super Snap: homing attack up to 2 times that deals good damage and slows the target.   
Power: 6 base damage per hit   
Refill 2 seconds on each hit to the time limit.

Super Combo: A 4 Hit combo that deals damage and slows the target.  
Power: 4 hearts base damage each hit, 6 on final hit.  
Refill 2 seconds on the transformation with each hit.

Okay now that we have everything regarding the chaos emeralds down, we should definitely discuss the master emerald. 

MASTER EMERALD

Before we discuss Pseudo Super (Chaos Form) Let us discuss some aspects of the master emerald that makes it so important. The master emerald has these features:

Buffs the player with Regeneration while nearby

Allows the player to neutralize enemies using super/hyper forms nearby by right clicking the master emerald to send a pulse of form negating energy.

Standing atop the emerald and pressing the transform buttons will grant the player pseudo super (chaos) form.

Shattering the master emerald using dark emeralds ability. 

Combine nine into a crafting table to re-create the master emerald. The player may use one shard in their hands to shatter it, gaining the same chaos form anywhere they please. But this consumes the jade fragment completely. Duplicating the jade fragment requires shattering 9 master emeralds, or crafting a jade shard using these ingredients:   
(Blank top slot being the jade fragment. You keep the fragment like you do with smithing template copying)

![][image2]

Now, lets address the ritual for the super emeralds, and chaos form.

Super emeralds are only obtainable after beating the ender dragon due to the balance factors. To obtain them, you need:

Master Emerald, located.  
All 7 chaos emeralds  
The 7 recharge pillars around the master emerald   
7 antique tablets that show the player how to perform the ritual. The ritual cannot be completed until the player has opened the tablet (retextured book pretty much) and read the message, telling the player the emeralds unique placement on one of the 7 pillars. Where these placements are depend entirely on your preference. But its imperative the tablets must be found before doing the ritual. Once all 7 are obtained (or each individual one) the player places the emerald(s) on the corresponding pillar, and right click the emerald. Instead of releasing a form ending pulse, it sends out a pulse that transforma any and every emerald correctly placed on each pillar into a super emerald.

Finally, chaos form: 

Chaos Form: 4 Minutes.  
Can be added onto other forms.  
No cooldown, since master emerald cant be picked up.  
Achieved by standing on the master emerald and pressing the transformation button  
When sprinting on the ground, the player destroys blocks in a 3x3 area ahead of them

Stats and abilities:  
Hover in the air by holding jump  
Speed 3  
Attack 2   
Resistance 2  
Water Running.  
Step assist.

Ability: Chest Orbs  
User shoots out three energy orbs that deal insane damage  Can be used to end transformation early, dealing good damage. If in super form, deals more damage and ends form immediately. In hyper, deals even more damage and ends form immediately. If used in dark form, it doesn't end the form. It does however pause health draining from said form.  
Cooldown of 10 Minutes

Super Base Damage: 9 each orb BD

Ability: Forward Charge

Slams the body forward in a spindash, dealing good knockback and afflicting the target with slow 2\. Flies 10 blocks forward where the mouse is looking.

Ability: Gatling Wrist  
Fire a burst of 8 inaccurate projectiles from your wrist dealing light damage.

Now for the Dark emerald. This emerald is only obtained by a dark ritual that infuses the emerald with the withers energy. 

Step 1: place the blue emerald on the ground near the master emerald.

Step 2:  place these items around the blue emerald:  
![][image3]  
Then simply right click the nearby master emerald. This will suck the blue emeralds positive energy, while overloading the blue emerald with negative energy. 

Dark Form:

Transformation only triggers when you have a dark emerald in your inventory, and you are on low damage. Transform on 3 hearts or less.

Heals to full health once transformed.

Drains one heart per second. Cannot heal from food or potion effects. Chaos form combined with this form disables health draining. 

If combined, transformation ends once chaos form fades away. Cannot combine with any forms besides chaos

Costs 15 levels to recharge.

Stats:  
Speed 3  
Attack 2  
Resistance: 3

Passive: Slain mobs heal 2 hearts and increase attack by 2 for 4 seconds.

Abilities:  
Dark Rush: Teleport behind the target and perform a dark slash attack. For 4 seconds the player has guaranteed crits from back attacks.  
Power: 6 Base Power  
Cooldown: 8 seconds.

Dark Slash Combo: Deals a 5 hit combo that restores half a heart with every hit, and inflicts poison status.  
Power: 3 Base Power Each Hit. 6 for final strike.  
Cooldown: 15 seconds.

The super emerald version is done the exact same way, except you must do it with a blue super emerald, and must right click the master emerald with a nether star. The form is the same as the form just mentioned, however it has no hp drain, making the dark emerald somewhat obsolete. 

Before talking about the super emeralds, let's talk about ancient tablets and the chaos emerald power generator. 

Ancient tablets can be found in end chests, these tablets show placements to transmute chaos emeralds into super emeralds.

The chaos emerald energy generator produces power in forge power units. Only chaos emeralds are acceptable as power sources for this machine. One at a time inisde the machine. Each machine outputs 5,000 FE/t. Infinite energy. (I have a 7 emerald generator i wanna eventually work in too for late game  but thats after the mods foundation is set.)

Flight drains hunger at a lesser rate than super

UPDATE 2 Energy and Skill update.

1 Each emerald has a skill tree of 7 abilities and upgrades unlockable with exp gained from going super. Super grants 1 exp, hyper grants 3\. Most abilities cost 5 levels of form exp besides ultimate abilities. Later updates, after everything is done forms may have skill trees as well.

2 A generator that outputs 10x forge energy as the individual emeralds, but requires 7 to be placed inside to use. 

3 Orange and Pink chaos emeralds found in the end, they don't have abilities or buffs, however they power chaos emerald machines and can be used to power up chaos/metal echo   
(next update)

4 Portal Ring: Can be used to throw out a bigger ring portal that transports you to either spawn/bed or your very own special stage pocket dimension (9x9 chunks)

5 A few decorative blocks:  
Things such as the player fighting chaos stone painting, an altar for the master emerald, some emerald themed light sources, and master emerald shard blocks for decoration, including bricks, polished, stairs, slabs, all the works.

6: Chaos Emerald Turret: (create)  
An altar powered by a chaos emerald and rotational energy. The rotation determines how fast this fires. The chaos emerald you place floats in this machine, firing upon your desired targets. passive, neutrals, hostiles, players, everything.

UPDATE 3 Friends and Foes

1 Massive pillager and illager raids, where they attempt to harness the master emeralds power for themselves, utilizing chaos form near the master emerald to become more dangerous, but also rewarding rare items specific to the mod, like materials used for the advanced emerald locator, or a crown that reduces recharge costs and has an ability of some sort.

2 Metal version of minecraft players, dubbed metal echo, has an inventory, and can be powered up with a chaos emerald. Can be mass produced to create a powerful army, however this creation requires a block of diamond, and 5 robot pieces assembled in create mod to make, so it's difficult to do so. If this creation is destroyed, so too is the emerald. Can be powered up further in a few ways.

3 Chaos, the monster of the master emerald. Tameable by feeding emeralds, which also raise its hp and attack. Can shoot powerful jets pf water, or attack directly. This beast fights for you like a dog, can also be told to stay or go same as well.  but be careful, if you feed it 7 emeralds you'll have to fight perfect chaos, requiring a super form to defeat. This will reward the player with jade fragments and materials to craft the pillars, the necklace that prevents chaos from going rogue, the ring required to access false supers (chaos form) levitation as a permanent while wearing, and material to craft the perfected chaos generator 

4 Creeper Mind Control Helmet:  
Tames creepers, allowing the player to use them as suicide bombers. Can mechanize them in a later update to enhance explosion damage and radius. 

5 Dark Gaia Minions:  
Dark gaia has been sleeping ever since its first defeat. It sends its minions periodically underground in darkness to find the emeralds to set it free once more. These minions will attempt to kill you. They drop Dark Fragments, that can be assembled into a number of items.They rarely drop a Dark Heart that is used in powerful recipes.These minions kill every single mob besides themselves, including passive and aggressive mobs.  
What they craft into:

Remote Signal Input (create mod)  
Using the remote, this block acts as an input for the remote. The rotational output can be remotely disabled, allowing for long distance remote control useage, as long as the user is close enough.

Remote Controller: The remote for the  

Chips Ring: Converts EXP into healing. One exp \= 1 hp restored.

Target Designator: a remote you can use to focus badniks and metal echo on any targets. 

Over-Drives: Boost your robots\! Metal echo, Creep machines, and Creep mobiles receive speed and attack with a dark aura for 3 minutes when applied with right click.

This material is used in the armor set, and in most creep machines/ creepmobiles, as well as accessories. Its sort of a base mod material.

6: Wolf Vest:  
A simple leather vest that increases wolf defense. You can attach a chaos emerald to it, to further increase defense, and increase hp, speed, attack, and jump height. 

UPDATE 4 Machines and Creeps 

1 Energy Emitter  
Powered by chaos emeralds. This field disabled the ability to destroy blocks. More chaos emeralds inserted increases range. Prevents explosions, and teleportation as well.

2 Physics Pad  
Powered by creates rotational energy. Acts as a sort of gravity lift with an adjustable power/height

3 Creepmobile (Requires Create)  
A flying vehicle you can craft using a somewhat complicated create recipe. This vehicle goes slow, but you can place chaos emeralds inside it to make it stronger and go faster. This machine can cloak the mobile in electricity, making any hits or contact to this machine deal damage 

4 Creep Machine (Requires Create)  
Create machines that resemble badniks\! These machines are powered by the animals they are designed after. When these machines are destroyed, they drop scrap you can wash to receive some materials back. When creep machines are destroyed, they have a delayed explosion that destroys the machine and deals damage, but drops the animal and scrap.

Axolotl Creep Machine  
Tankiest machine. Has 6 hearts. Deals slow and strong melee damage. Isn't as fast as the other 2\.

Parrot Creep Machine  
Repairs nearby creep machines. Can do a simple swoop attack. Has 4 hearts.

Rabbit Creep Machine  
Long range unit. Can shoot energy projectiles at targets. Has 3 hearts. This unit tends to keep their distance.

Animal Cage  
Used to capture rabbits, parrots, and axolotls. Right click the cage on a badnik to load it into a creep machine. 

5 Command Wheel  
Holding a button brings up a command wheel for your robots, with actions such as attack, defend, patrol, stay, and follow. If used looking at a specific robot, only that robot receives the command. If not, all robots within a decent range will listen.

6 E Chest Link (create useable)  
Dropping anything into this will deposit said item into your personal ender chest. If you have create installed, you can place a funnel on this machine to extract said items as well.

FINAL UPDATE (5)

1 Sol Emeralds: Essentially do nothing as you cant harness their powers, however one machine can utilize them. They are found in your pocket dimension, located in structures. These structures Regenerate these stones everry few days.

2 Creepmobile Upgrades:  
Installable new weapons. Can only have one weapon equipped at a time.

Weapons:   
Drill ( Requires Purple Sol Emerald)  
Fast drill that cuts through blocks like a knife. Deals continuous weak damage that bypasses invincibility frames. 

Sweeping Laser (Requires Yellow Sol Emerald)  
A set of three lasers that start upwards, and sweeps downwards where you're looking

Arc Cannon: (Requires L Blue Sol Emerald)  
This vehicle can go underwater. Shoot strong arcs of lightning that deal double damage underwater. Movement of vehicle is as fast as above water, and the player can see perfectly.

Fire Bomb (Requires Red Sol Emerald)  
Drop a glob of fire that explodes a large magma pillar into the sky. Deals rapid damage.

Icycle Shotgun (Requires Blue Sol Emerald)  
Revolve fragments of sharp ice around your vehicle. These shards can be shot where the player is looking to force them forward like a shotgun. The fragments deal damage on contact.

Toxic Fog (Requires Grey Sol Emerald)  
Release fog under the vehicle, that shortly combusts into an explosion. While in the fog, darkness, slow, and hunger. Explosion deals good damage

Creep Missiles (Requires Green Sol Emerald)  
Shoot a volley of three slow moving good tracking missiles that explode on impact, destroying blocks and inflicting slow 3 and weakness for 4 seconds. 

3 Neo Metal Echo (Requires Create)  
Use a basin with a mixer, add Iron block, blaze rod, and potion of strength 2\. Blend it together and you'll get Metal Goop. This goop is dangerous, applying the metal virus, which spreads and infects anything it touches. The only cure is to transform. But it's essentially just another variant of wither that doesn't turn off once it infects you. Can be filled in a bucket for transport, and fill in a liquid tank. HOWEVER, if you apply a bucket of this liquid to Metal Echo (without a chaos emerald equipped) it turns into Neo Metal Echo. This version is more powerful, more intelligent, and has a few abilities, like the option to turn super if it holds all 7 chaos emeralds in its slots. It can use the same super moves you can, and it has the same time limits. The only tradeoff is, if you give it too much power, it might rebel. That is however unless you craft a control chip and apply it to neo. This chip is very abhorrently expensive, so if you do this without a contingency you will have a rough time. 

4 Biome Spreader  
Spread the biome you choose to spread across a 10x10 area. Requires a chaos emerald, and drains it after a conversion.

5 Chaos Emerald Physical Storage (Hammer Space)  
A small inventory that you can place your chaos, super, sol, and master emeralds.
